routes.title: The Star of La Mu, Targeted

rows.en: ...I see. AI1's learning seems to be progressing smoothly.
Yes. I think it will be ready to move on to Level 3 very soon.
How are those two doing?
They seem to be gradually getting the hang of piloting #機体名.
However...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing conjunction retained.

rows.en: What is it?
If #男姓名 learns his true identity, I believe he will be even more suspicious of you than before.
rows.notes: His true identity stays unnamed; source explicitly uses male pronoun. Do not reveal hidden character.
uncertain: Unnamed male true-identity referent retained rather than exposed.

rows.en: There's no need to worry. Whatever #男姓名 may think of me...
rows.notes: Cross-row conditional continues into row8; preserved ellipsis.

rows.en: He has no choice but to obey me... if he wants to get that medicine.
I've read the report. Isn't taking that medicine dangerous?
I'm well aware of that. Besides, he can't survive without it. That's the state his body is in.
More to the point, are you all right with #女姓名 finding out who you really are...?
rows.notes: Source unfinished identity-revelation clause retained with English question structure.

rows.en: I intend to keep it secret for a while. But one of her flaws is that she has trouble controlling her emotions...
rows.notes: Source ellipsis retained; female lead is explicit source referent.

rows.en: If we choose the right moment, we can turn that to our advantage.
I see... You'll unsettle her when the need arises.
As always, you see people in only two ways... either they are useful to you, or they aren't.
The same goes for you, Doctor, doesn't it?
Heh... Indeed it does.
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing wrapper and @ indent per brief.

rows.en: So, how far along is the Tsentr Project?
It's a little behind schedule... but the frames for Units 8 and 9 will be complete soon. The rest depends on the materials.
rows.notes: Materials left unspecified as in source, without invented project explanation.

rows.en: What about the Federation Army's investigation into the theft of the Medius?
rows.notes: Source shortened Medius retained rather than expanded to Medius Locus.

rows.en: I've had the committee put pressure on them. There is no problem.
...Understood.
rows.notes: Eldy acknowledges title correction.

rows.en: Finally... do you have any requests?
Since we operate with only one unit, AI1's learning subjects are limited. I'd like to do something about that...
rows.notes: Single unit is their operating platform; learning subjects means opponents/sample targets, clarified by rows24-26.

rows.en: Are you saying the Nahel Argama team, with some of the Federation Army's finest fighting strength, isn't good enough for you?
No... I want to give AI1 as much learning material as possible.
Very well... I'll arrange for improved versions of Units 1 and 2. The military won't notice those.
Thank you very much.
Also... I've arranged a channel to the Giganos forces.
If necessary, go to them... and gather data.
Understood. Well then...
rows.notes: Departure formula retains trailing ellipsis.

rows.en: My, my... Mutropolis really is impressive. No wonder it withstood that ferocious onslaught by the Demon Empire.
So, what can I do for you? You're with Amato News...
rows.notes: Hibiki searches for reporter name; Amato News... fragment answered by row33.

rows.en: I'm Johji Futagami.
rows.notes: Full source name uses glossary Johji Futagami.

rows.en: By the way, Doctor, have you heard about the recent Operation Overlord?
...No, I haven't.
Oh? Now, that is strange.
You helped TERRA investigate and analyze the Mu, yet you weren't told about that operation?
rows.notes: Restored source subject you and question verb; courteous probing register.

rows.en: That's only natural. I'm a civilian, after all.
I see. I read your report, 'Observations on Fossil Beasts and Dolems'...
rows.notes: Report title translated; Fossil Beasts centrally confirmed against Akurasu Impact Unit Database. Plural class form.

rows.en: To write a report like that and still receive no word... My, my, TERRA certainly treats you coldly.
So, what is it you want?
Sorry, I got sidetracked. You see, after Operation Overlord...
rows.notes: Sentence continues in next packet: rumor of a giant from TOKYO JUPITER; trailing ellipsis preserved.

rows.en: I heard a rumor that a mysterious giant appeared from TOKYO JUPITER.
rows.notes: Futagami continues his interview with Hibiki after mentioning Operation Overlord.

rows.en: A mysterious giant...
rows.notes: Echoed noun phrase is a deliberate repetition of Futagami's wording.

rows.en: Apparently, it bore some resemblance to Raideen. That's why I came here to ask you about it.
rows.notes: Futagami explains why he came to interview Hibiki: resemblance to Raideen.

rows.en: I'm afraid Raideen hasn't been deployed at all in the past few days...
rows.notes: Hibiki says Raideen did not deploy recently.

rows.en: I see. And it hasn't shown any unusual behavior, either?
rows.notes: Futagami follows up about unusual behavior of Raideen.

rows.en: ...That's right.
rows.notes: Affirms that Raideen showed no unusual behavior; stray closing wrapper and trailing source break discarded per brief.

rows.en: I see. It seems I jumped to conclusions. My apologies, my apologies.
rows.notes: Futagami politely retracts his supposed assumption.
Deliberate silence preserved.

rows.en: Then, just one final question. Where is your wife... Reiko Hibiki, now?
rows.notes: Futagami asks Hibiki where his wife is. Full Reiko Hibiki sourced by root from Akurasu Master Characters List; no Lemuria identity added.

rows.en: ...She passed away. After the final battle against the Demon Empire...
rows.notes: Hibiki answers the wife question; she died after the Demon Empire final battle.

rows.en: That was terribly rude of me.
rows.notes: Futagami apologizes to Hibiki for the intrusive question.

rows.en: This man... How does he know about Reiko? He said he was a reporter, but... who is he really?
rows.notes: Hibiki privately questions Futagami's knowledge and claimed reporter profession. Short Reiko follows source, sourced by root from Akurasu Master Characters List. Opening This man... is a deliberate source fragment.

rows.en: Dr. Hibiki, an unidentified object is approaching Mutropolis!
rows.notes: Director interrupts the interview with an approach warning.

rows.en: What!? Could it be them!?
rows.notes: Hibiki suspects the arriving group; no premature identification added.

rows.en: Them...? Does he mean the Mu?
rows.notes: Futagami interprets Hibiki's 'them' as the Mu, in thought.

rows.en: No, it isn't!
rows.notes: Director denies Hibiki's suspected identity, not the object's approach.

rows.en: How is the Federation military responding!?
rows.notes: Hibiki asks the Director what the Federation is doing.

rows.en: I'm told the Nahel Argama squad is heading here, but they'll be just a little too late!
rows.notes: Reinforcements are coming but will narrowly miss arriving in time.

rows.en: I'll send Akira and Mari out!
rows.notes: Director orders the sortie of Akira and Mari.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: Who are they...!?
rows.notes: Mari reacts to unidentified attackers; no species/identity specified.

rows.en: Those machines... Who do they belong to? At least they aren't Bahbem's...
rows.notes: Futagami wonders about affiliation; Bahbem remains a possessive short name as in source.

rows.en: Mari, reinforcements will be here soon! Find some way to hold out until then!
rows.notes: Director tells Mari to hold until reinforcements arrive.

rows.en: Right!
rows.notes: Mari acknowledges the Director.

rows.en: We don't know what the enemy is after. Be very careful how you respond!
rows.notes: Hibiki warns Mari to respond cautiously because enemy objective is unknown.

rows.en: Yes! By the way, where's Akira!?
rows.notes: Mari asks Hibiki where Akira is.

rows.en: He'll be deploying right away!
rows.notes: Restored he = Akira from Mari's immediately preceding question; not Hibiki deploying.

rows.en: Raideeeeen!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker stays ??? despite context; stretched Raideen cry.

rows.en: So Raideen, guardian deity of the ancient Mu Empire, makes its entrance...
rows.notes: Ancient Raideen Mu Empire remains distinct from the RahXephon Mu.

rows.en: But unlike the war against the Demon Empire, 5A is outside this time.
rows.notes: 5A retained unexpanded. Outside's likely referent is TOKYO JUPITER, but source does not spell it out.
uncertain: Outside is left unspecified as in the source; likely outside TOKYO JUPITER.

rows.en: Now, how will the Bahbem Foundation respond...? This should be quite a sight.
rows.notes: Futagami privately anticipates the Bahbem Foundation reaction.

rows.en: All right, I'll close Mutropolis' shell! I'm counting on you, Mari and Akira!
rows.notes: Director asks Mari and Akira to defend Mutropolis; asking direction preserved with I'm counting on you.

rows.en: Yes, you can count on me!
rows.notes: Akira's reply offers his help; you can count on me preserves direction.

rows.en: Here I go!
rows.notes: Akira's battle launch cry; restores first-person subject.

rows.en: Goddamn! I can't believe this is the end for me!!
rows.notes: Event 5 defeat line, not continuous banter in event 8; goddamn keeps force of English loanword.

rows.en: Uoooh!?
rows.notes: Event 5 defeat cry, preserved as a nonverbal vocalization.

rows.en: Mutron energy isn't a power you can master!
rows.notes: Akira addresses the replica attackers about their inability to master Mutron energy.

rows.en: Like we give a damn about that!
rows.notes: Replica Chibodee dismisses Akira's warning about Mutron mastery.

rows.en: Hand over the Star of Ra Mu to us if you value your lives.
rows.notes: Replica Argo demands the Star from defenders; plural lives follows collective you in surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Not a chance! I won't let you do whatever you like with Mutron energy!
rows.notes: Akira refuses the Star demand and says he will prevent misuse of Mutron energy.

rows.en: Answer me! Who created you and is controlling you!?
rows.notes: Domon addresses replicas; asks their creator/controller, not the genuine allies.

rows.en: I told you, Japanese! We've got no business with you!
rows.notes: Replica Chibodee rebuffs Domon, retaining 'Japanese' address.

rows.en: Whose orders are you acting on!?
rows.notes: Domon again demands the replicas' commander.

rows.en: If you want to know, ask my fists... Heh heh heh. That's what you people say, isn't it?
rows.notes: Replica Argo mocks the fighters' maxim rather than answering Domon.

rows.en: You bastard...!
rows.notes: Angry direct insult and trailing-off force retained.

rows.en: You bastard! How dare you make a mockery of the Shuffle Alliance I look up to!!
rows.notes: Ginga angrily addresses the counterfeit fighters; retains insult and his admiration.

rows.en: Ha! What an innocent little boy! Here's your reward... a punch from me, even stronger than the real thing!
rows.notes: Counterfeit Chibodee boasts that his punch surpasses the original.

rows.en: You dare come at me? You really are a child... You can't even tell how much stronger I am.
rows.notes: Counterfeit Argo taunts Ginga over their strength gap.

rows.en: Shut up! There's no way I'm losing to some fake Argo Gulski!!
rows.notes: Full Argo name follows glossary.
Intentional silence; same source row also used at battle-map uses409,587,600, all contexts checked.

rows.en: What's wrong, boy? Are you wetting yourself in that cockpit?
rows.notes: Chibodee taunts silent Shinji; preserves wetting-self insult.

rows.en: What are you doing, Shinji?! Once guys like him think you're a pushover, they just get more and more cocky!
rows.notes: Asuka warns Shinji that being seen as a pushover emboldens this opponent.
uncertain: Read once they look down on Shinji as the intended direction of the warning.

rows.en: You're a feisty one, girl! Just wait... I'll take you on after I'm done with this kid!
rows.notes: Chibodee answers Asuka and refers to Shinji as this kid.

rows.en: W-with power like that, I don't know how long even my AT Field can hold out...!
rows.notes: Shinji fears even his AT Field will fail against this power.

rows.en: Ikari...!
rows.notes: Rei calls Shinji by surname, as source; name-call fragment.

rows.en: What's wrong, kid?! If you won't come at me, I'll come at you!
rows.notes: Argo challenges the youngster; threat direction retained without inventing identity.

rows.en: Those punches are so fast... There's no way I can dodge every single one...!
rows.notes: Female lead cannot evade all the punches; explicit I restored.

rows.en: That's right, young lady! I, Chibodee Crocket... never fail to finish off the prey I set my sights on!
rows.notes: Full name follows glossary; hunting boast retained.

rows.en: That's a hell of a thing for a fake to say!
rows.notes: Male lead rejects counterfeit Chibodee boast.

rows.en: The power of the Chibodee Crocket I know...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished topic continues in row101; source present-tense knowledge and matching boundary preserved.

rows.en: The man who fought the Devil Gundam was far stronger than this!
rows.notes: Male lead compares fake to the real Chibodee who fought Devil Gundam.

rows.en: #男愛称...
rows.notes: Female lead addresses male lead by runtime nickname; vocative fragment.

rows.en: Ugh... This power... I should have expected as much...!
rows.notes: Male lead acknowledges surprising power; his evaluation continues naturally.

rows.en: You realized that too late! My next blow will tear you to pieces!
rows.notes: Argo mistakes the acknowledgment for submission and threatens dismemberment.

rows.en: Don't get the wrong idea! Argo Gulski's true strength is beyond anything a fake like you could muster!
rows.notes: Male lead means genuine Argo fighting seriously; fake remains far inferior.

rows.en: #男愛称... You know the Shuffle Alliance...?
rows.notes: Female lead asks male lead about his prior knowledge.

rows.en: Right now, forget about that and focus on taking him down!!
rows.notes: Male lead redirects female lead to defeating the opponent.

rows.en: Oh! The Nahel Argama team has come to help us!
rows.notes: Event10 arrival; director welcomes the Nahel Argama team.

rows.en: Are you all right, Akira?!
rows.notes: Ryoma checks Akira safety.

rows.en: Yes, Ryoma! I'm all right!
rows.notes: Akira answers Ryoma affirmatively; full subject/action restored.

rows.en: All units, launch! Support Raideen and defend Mutropolis!
rows.notes: Bright orders launch, Raideen support and Mutropolis defense.

rows.en: Ah! That enemy...
rows.notes: Deliberate recognition fragment; referent left as source enemy.

rows.en: Do you recognize it?
rows.notes: Male lead asks female lead whether she recognizes enemy.

rows.en: I feel like I've seen it somewhere before...
rows.notes: Female lead uncertainly remembers seeing it; I restored.

rows.en: Really?!
rows.notes: Male lead asks whether recognition is genuine.

rows.en: But only part of it looks like that one. Maybe I'm just imagining things...?
rows.notes: Thought; unidentified comparison target remains that one, without invented identity.
uncertain: Comparison target is intentionally unnamed; only partial resemblance is established.

rows.en: Oh...? So they've assigned the Evangelions to that unit.
rows.notes: Thought; Futagami observes Evangelion deployment to the team.

rows.en: The people at NERV have made quite a bold move. Their aim... Is it to draw the attention of those in their way?
rows.notes: Thought; NERV bold move and speculation about drawing attention retained.
uncertain: Those in their way is an unspecified group; no identity inferred.

rows.en: 1. Raideen destroyed@2. God Gundam destroyed@3. Allied mothership destroyed
rows.notes: Plain defeat conditions; three segments and two @ preserved.

rows.en: Multiple heat signatures detected underground!!
rows.notes: Torres reports multiple underground heat signatures.

rows.en: Under the ground?!
rows.notes: Bright surprised at underground location.

rows.en: Th-these readings...!!
rows.notes: Rain recognition trails off with stutter; deliberate fragment.

rows.en: The Death Army!!
rows.notes: Male lead recognizes Death Army; exclamatory identification.

rows.en: Th-they're back again!!
rows.notes: Ple reacts to Death Army reappearance; stutter retained.

rows.en: Why are they here of all places...?!
rows.notes: Domon questions why Death Army is here.

rows.en: But there's no heat signature like the Devil Gundam's anywhere nearby...
rows.notes: Rain reports no nearby Devil Gundam heat signature; trailing statement.

rows.en: What on earth are they after...?!
rows.notes: Domon asks Death Army aim.

rows.en: Hahahaha! You wouldn't understand, Japanese!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker remains ??? despite identifying voice in neighbors.

rows.en: That voice...?!
rows.notes: Domon recognizes voice without naming speaker; recognition fragment.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... It's been a while.
rows.notes: Chibodee addresses Domon; sinister chuckle and reunion.

rows.en: Chibodee! Chibodee Crocket!
Heh heh heh heh...
rows.notes: Source chuckle retained.

rows.en: And Argo! Even you...!
rows.notes: Direct address to Argo; source deliberately trails off.

rows.en: Chibodee and Argo... They're members of the Shuffle Alliance too.
Then, just like last time, they're also...!?
rows.notes: Kaine recalls the earlier clone encounter; retain unfinished inference.
uncertain: Earlier encounter recalled by Kaine is not uniquely identified within the examined Stage9 neighborhood; deliberately unfinished inference is retained.

rows.en: Hmph, that's right. You've already figured it out. Then there's no need for any tricks.
You two... Just what are you?
Ha ha ha! You figured it out ages ago, didn't you, Domon Kasshu!?
We're clones... made with DG Cells, based on data from the Shuffle Alliance...
That's right. Your brother, Kyoji Kasshu's double...
rows.notes: First part of the comparison completed in row141; brother refers to Domon's Kyoji.

rows.en: We're just like that Schwarz Bruder, ha ha ha ha!
rows.notes: Schwarz / Schwarz Bruder spelling confirmed centrally from Akurasu Master Characters List and A Pilot Database.
Nonverbal surprise at both s0220:290 and s0220:310.

rows.en: Though the data for Schwarz and your master, the Undefeated of the East...
rows.notes: Data clause continues in row144; preserve source title Undefeated of the East. Schwarz / Schwarz Bruder spelling confirmed centrally from Akurasu Master Characters List and A Pilot Database.

rows.en: You completely wiped it out a year ago, so we can never create them again, but...
rows.notes: Domon destroyed the data a year ago; them refers to Schwarz and his master.

rows.en: They have power equal to the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings...
rows.notes: They refers to the Shuffle Alliance members described in row146; statement spans rows145-146.

rows.en: And the Shuffle Alliance still exists today, so creating DG Cell clones of its members was easy.
No...! Who made you, and what on earth for...!?
You have no need to know that...!
Of course! And unlike Schwarz, who was imperfect, we...
rows.notes: Contrast continues into row150; imperfect describes Schwarz. Schwarz / Schwarz Bruder spelling confirmed centrally from Akurasu Master Characters List and A Pilot Database.

rows.en: We're perfect soldiers, free of any worthless doubts!
That's right... We've even surpassed the power of the originals...
rows.notes: Clone boast deliberately trails off before Domon interrupts.

rows.en: Ridiculous!!

rows.notes: Source startled punctuation retained.

rows.en: However well you imitate their looks and power... Without inheriting the Shuffle Crest and its soul, you're nothing but wooden puppets!!
rows.notes: Wooden puppets retains the insult and physical metaphor; crest and soul both retained.

rows.en: You can never surpass Chibodee or Argo!!
Hah! But we have a power that you don't!
That's right! The DG Cells that tormented you Kasshu brothers!!
...My brother Kyoji... Schwarz... And my master...
rows.notes: Deliberate list of loved ones; sibling relationship retained. Schwarz / Schwarz Bruder spelling confirmed centrally from Akurasu Master Characters List and A Pilot Database.

rows.en: I can't let anyone else suffer the way they and I did!
Ha ha ha ha! Of course, of course you can't!
But, Japanese! Even greater suffering than back then awaits you all!
That's right... A crisis beyond anything from a year ago...!

rows.notes: Runtime speaker placeholder retained verbatim; silent alarm.

rows.en: Shut up! You scum who disgrace the Shuffle name... I'll defeat you with my own hands!
Here I go! Gundam Fiiight...!!
rows.notes: Gundam Fight call is interrupted before its usual conclusion.

rows.en: Whoa, hold on. We didn't come here to fight you.
! Then what is your purpose!?
Our purpose... is to obtain the Star of Ra Mu.

rows.notes: Source startled punctuation retained.

rows.en: Why do they want the Star of Ra Mu...!?
rows.notes: Restored want from explicit acquisition aim at row168.

rows.en: Could it be... to obtain Mutron energy...!?
rows.notes: Restored purpose question; source uncertainty retained.

rows.en: If so, the ones behind them are... Good grief, this looks like it's going to get complicated.
rows.notes: Futagami privately infers the backers but does not name them; thought kind.
uncertain: The implied backers are deliberately unnamed; English does not resolve their identity.

rows.en: What do you intend to do once you have the Star of Ra Mu!?
I don't need to tell you that.
Just shut up and hand the Star of Ra Mu over to us.
rows.notes: Glossary correction after meaning review: Star of La Mu -> Star of Ra Mu.

rows.en: Like hell! I swore to my mom back then...!
That I'd use Mutron energy to do what's right!!
rows.notes: Continues the oath in 176; retained That-clause at matching row boundary.

rows.en: Then it looks like we'll have to take it by force!
All enemy readings have disappeared!
Akira, are you all right?
Yeah, somehow. Still... why did they want the Star of Ra Mu...?
rows.notes: Glossary correction after meaning review: Star of La Mu -> Star of Ra Mu.

rows.en: So that's the Nahel Argama squad... They're as good as the rumors say. Well, I'd better disappear before I give myself away.
Now then... I wonder if there's any hope left in Pandora's box?
Thank you, Captain Bright Noa. You saved us.
rows.notes: Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank [jp] to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: You're welcome... More importantly, I'd like you to tell us about the Star of Ra Mu.
rows.notes: Glossary correction after meaning review: Star of La Mu -> Star of Ra Mu.

rows.en: Of course. The Star of Ra Mu, which the enemy was after, is...
rows.notes: Glossary correction after meaning review: Star of La Mu -> Star of Ra Mu.

rows.en: The source of the super energy Mutron, handed down from the ancient Mu Empire, and the device that releases it.
rows.notes: Continues the definition begun in 186; retained noun-phrase continuation at matching row boundary.

rows.en: The source of Mutron... A device that releases it...
rows.notes: Deliberate echo of the explanation, retaining source noun-phrase fragments.

rows.en: Yes. You can think of the star itself as a mass of Mutron energy.
...It looks like that...
rows.notes: Vega keeps comparison object unnamed; that remains unresolved in this scene.
uncertain: Comparison object intentionally unnamed; no identity supplied.

rows.en: What sort of power does it have, specifically?
We have yet to fully understand the Star of Ra Mu and Mutron energy, but...
rows.notes: Glossary correction after meaning review: Star of La Mu -> Star of Ra Mu.

rows.en: In the final battle with Barao, king of the Demon Empire, it made Raideen grow to an enormous size...
rows.notes: Star is the subject, Raideen grows; Barao title translated only as source king.

rows.en: And since Raideen defeated him, we believe the star possesses phenomenal power.
rows.notes: Raideen defeats Barao; the star possesses the inferred power.

rows.en: It grew to an enormous size...
Just like the giant of light. The one I saw in Antarctica back then...
rows.notes: Trailing Antarctica memory stays unfinished; no added identity for giant of light.

rows.en: But why did they... Why did the DG clones of Chibodee and Argo come after the Star of Ra Mu?
rows.notes: Glossary correction after meaning review: Star of La Mu -> Star of Ra Mu.

rows.en: I think they probably intended to use it to revive the Devil Gundam.
What...?
If the Star of Ra Mu has enough power to make Raideen grow to an enormous size...
rows.notes: Conditional trails into the following row, matching source boundary. Glossary correction after meaning review: Star of La Mu -> Star of Ra Mu.

rows.en: It should also be able to activate the DG Cells and enhance those three major functions.
rows.notes: Restored star as It; the three major functions remain unspecified as in source.

rows.en: And if they use the Star of Ra Mu as the Devil Gundam's power source...
rows.notes: Conditional trails into the following row, matching source boundary. Glossary correction after meaning review: Star of La Mu -> Star of Ra Mu.

rows.en: You mean it might become even more powerful than it was last time?
Yes...
Then, Dr. Hibiki, where is the Star of Ra Mu?
rows.notes: Glossary correction after meaning review: Star of La Mu -> Star of Ra Mu.

rows.en: My wife, Reiko... No, Lemuria, princess of the Mu Empire, who awoke from her ancient slumber, sealed it away somewhere...
rows.notes: Hibiki corrects wife Reiko to Princess Lemuria; ancient awakening and unknown sealing location retained.

rows.en: And now we don't know where it is.
So you're saying it isn't here?
...Yes, that's right.
It's been a while, Akira. Have you been doing well?
Yes. Thank you for your help back there.
No need to thank me. We've always helped each other out like that.
Hey, is that kid Raideen's pilot?
rows.notes: Asuka asks the others about Akira in third person; retains dismissive kid.

rows.en: And who are you?
rows.notes: Akira turns question to Asuka; full subject and verb restored.

rows.en: I'm Asuka Langley Soryu, the designated pilot of EVA-02.
Huh? You are? But you still look like a kid...
What's that supposed to mean!? You're about the same age as me!
It's downright insulting to be treated like a child by another child!
rows.notes: Asuka addresses Akira; preserve offense at being patronized by a peer.

rows.en: ...Asuka, stop it. You only just met...
rows.notes: Shinji tries to calm Asuka; trailing hesitation retained.

rows.en: Oh, shut up! You stay out of this!
rows.notes: Asuka snaps at Shinji, not Akira.

rows.en: ...You've got a cute face, but a sharp tongue. You're just like Mari.
rows.notes: Akira compares Asuka's sharp words to Mari's; both traits retained.

rows.en: Hey! What's that supposed to mean?!
Exactly! I'll take the cute part, but I'm not letting the rest slide!
rows.notes: Asuka accepts the compliment while objecting to the comparison/criticism.

rows.en: Oh, boy. This is going to be rough.
It looks like we both have our share of trouble.
rows.notes: Shinji and Akira share the experience of dealing with their outspoken companions.

rows.en: You can say that again. ...By the way, are you an Evangelion pilot too?
Yeah... There's one other pilot, a girl named Rei Ayanami, but...
rows.notes: Rei Ayanami is the other pilot; female established by glossary. Source trailing but retained.

rows.en: Wow... I'm surprised the pilots of those things are kids about my age.
rows.notes: Akira expresses surprise at the young Evangelion pilots, following Shinji's answer.

rows.en: If that surprises you, Ginga and Hokuto, who pilot Dendoh, are only in fifth grade!
R-really?!
I'm surprised there are kids even younger than us middle schoolers...
If #女愛称 heard that... she'd get depressed all over again.
rows.notes: Koji's private age joke refers to female protagonist; gender sourced from Aqua profile.

rows.en: Um... Akira. Can I ask you something?
Sure.
...How did you end up fighting?
Why do you ask?
Well... um... I was just wondering.
rows.notes: Hesitant but full subject and verb restored.

rows.en: A year ago, when the Demon Empire appeared on the surface... a mysterious voice called to me.
It said, 'Awaken, brave warrior... The hour of destiny has come...'
rows.notes: Quoted recalled voice, not new speaker; brave warrior is the voice's address to Akira.

rows.en: It called to you?
Yeah. After that, I used fade-in to enter Raideen and ended up fighting the Demon Empire's Fossil Beasts.
rows.notes: fade-in is the glossary pilot-merging technique; Demon Empire and Fossil Beasts retained.

rows.en: I was confused at first... But that was the destiny I'd been given.
...Destiny, huh...
rows.notes: Deliberate internal echo of destiny retained as a fragment.

rows.en: By the way, Akira... Are you able to join us now?
Yes, along with Mari. I'll be counting on you from now on, too.
rows.notes: Akira asks Ryoma/group for continued cooperation; request direction retained.

rows.en: Yeah. And we'll be counting on you, too.
rows.notes: Ryoma reciprocates Akira's request; both subject and direction explicit.

rows.en: ...What have you found?
rows.notes: Scene changes to machine analysis; male protagonist requests Light's findings.

rows.en: There's no matching machine data, but that six-legged one we saw earlier was definitely made on Earth.
But identifying its manufacturer from the fragments we recovered is a bit...
rows.notes: Manufacturer identification from fragments deliberately trails off; no invented firm impossibility.

rows.en: I see...
rows.notes: Ignore stray Japanese closing wrapper and trailing break per brief.

rows.en: #女愛称... Didn't you say that machine looked familiar earlier?
Yes... I brought some data along, just in case, but...
rows.notes: Aqua supplies data but trails off in source.

rows.en: What's this one?
It's Prototype No. 1, developed by our project.
rows.notes: No. 1 is prototype numbering, not a unit nickname.

rows.en: Is this a TE Absorber too?
No, it isn't. None of the models from No. 1 through No. 5, Medius, have TE Engines installed.
rows.notes: Range includes Medius as No. 5; all Nos. 1-5 lack TE Engines.

rows.en: Hmm... If you took the legs off that machine we saw earlier, I do think it would resemble this No. 1.
rows.notes: Light compares the six-legged machine without its legs to prototype No. 1.

rows.en: But it's strange for our project's No. 1 to turn up now... and in such numbers, too.
rows.notes: Time of appearance and large number both preserved.

rows.en: Could it be a mass-produced model?
If so... who built them, and what for?
Could Zapat have... No, did the people who stole Medius send those things in?
rows.notes: Source short Medius retained; Zapat is surname of glossary Mitar Zapat. First clause deliberately interrupted; conjecture stays private.
